title: Carrington event solar storm

tellings.quote: Carrington event of 1859 so are you familiar with the solar storm of 1859 Carrington took out it would have taken out now the entire grid but it took out electrical lines

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up the Carrington event, a huge storm from the Sun that struck Earth in 1859. He says it knocked out electrical lines back then and that a storm like it today would take out the entire power grid. He raises it to show how exposed modern life would be to such an event.
